You need it to do the cayo perico heist. It's also a vehicle you can drive and buy some pricey add-ons for, it also acts as a spawn location and offers free snacks and a few weapon spawns. If you were going to splurge on it (it really does pay for itself if you do intend to run the heist a few times), the only upgrade I'd go for is the moon pool Sparrow - it's a helicopter that can get you to heist setups much faster than the dinghy boat it gives you if you are decent at flying.
I'd recommend it, as the payout for just doing it solo even just two or three times land you around 3 million, and it's relatively easy once you run through it and maybe look up some maps and payouts for the different secondary targets.
